items.title: "Suddenly Candace Owens is a lesbian"
items.summary: A researcher posting as EsoShaggy claimed that leaked data from 2007-08 dating sites tied Candace Owens's old email addresses to four lesbian dating profiles. The claim was unverified and Owens called it "the most Israel-coded accusations of all time", but the timeline ran with it: "Ur off this app for one day and suddenly Candace Owens is a lesbian" got 107K likes, "i don't have time for candace owens being a lesbian right now" got 127K, and "Candace Owens getting more pussy than me" got 96K.
